title: 第325章 万灵树之花第324章 斩杀匪众
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：混沌青葫第325章万灵树之花（..la）一场灭城之灾，弹指消弭。
秦月带着所有守城之人，朝着半空中的徐长生，齐齐躬身行礼。
“多谢前辈救命之恩！”
成千上万道声音汇在一起，发自肺腑，回荡在城墙内外。
徐长生从半空缓缓落下，目光扫过那些民壮和士卒的脸。
他看见那个抱着瘦猫的小姑娘不知何时也跑上了城墙，正躲在老妇人身后，探出半个脑袋，怯生生地望着他，眼里带着好奇和崇拜。
徐长生心中微动。
就在这一瞬。
他丹田深处，万灵树悄无声息地轻轻一颤。
那朵一直含苞未放的国运之花，缓缓舒展了一片花瓣。
一股温润醇厚的金色气流自花瓣中溢出，沿着经脉缓缓流转，浸润四肢百骸。
这股力量不同于灵气，它温暖而厚重，承载着万民民意。
是万民的信仰之力。
徐长生闭上眼睛，感受着体内那股新生的力量。
所谓国运之力，生发于民心。
生发于一个被护佑之人，发自心底的感激与信赖。
就像当初的陈三。
就像此刻，这满城百姓的目光。
那些目光落在他的身上，有敬畏，有感激，有崇拜。
万灵树的花苞，正在吸收着这些看似无形的东西，一点一点，悄悄地绽放。

徐长生睁开眼，眼底浮现一抹明悟。
这一条路，他真的走对了！
“秦城主，借一步说话。”
徐长生说完后，秦月没有片刻迟疑，立即将城防守备交给副将，跟着徐长生和胡娇娇走下城墙。
…………
秦月躬身抱拳道："前辈有何吩咐，晚辈定当竭尽全力。"
徐长生摇了摇头，"不用叫前辈，我姓徐，你唤我徐先生便可。此番出手，并非为了什么回报。"
秦月微微一怔，眼神中多了一抹钦佩。
她见过太多修行者了。
要么趾高气扬，不把凡人放在眼里。
要么出手相助后，必然要索取报酬。
当初青柳镇被灭之前，有一个路过的修士本可以出手相救，却因为镇子上凑不齐他开出的价码，甩袖离去。
而眼前这个人，明明拥有碾压一切的力量，却无私付出，不求回报。
这份胸襟和担当，让秦月瞬间生出无限好感。
"徐先生，有什么是晚辈可以效劳的？"
徐长生想了想，问道："临安城外，有多少村落？"
秦月没想到他会问这个，愣了一下才答道："大小村落共十七个，约有三千余户，一万多口人。"
"黑虎寨平日里经常劫掠这些村子？"
秦月眼中闪过一丝痛色，"一个月至少两三回。那些匪徒抢粮、抢物、抢人。他们把青壮掳去寨子里做苦力，把年轻女子……"
胡娇娇愤然道：“这种人渣就该慢慢炮制，你杀的太痛快了。”

“还没有其他类似于黑虎寨的匪徒？”
“还有一个双龙山。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 325 of Chaos Green Gourd: The Flower of the Ten Thousand Spirits Tree (..la) A city-destroying disaster was eliminated with a snap of a finger.
Qin Yue and all the city defenders bowed and saluted Xu Changsheng in mid-air.
"Thank you, senior, for saving your life!"
Thousands of voices came together, coming from the heart, echoing inside and outside the city walls.
Xu Changsheng slowly fell from mid-air, his eyes scanning the faces of the people and soldiers.
He saw that the little girl holding the skinny cat had also run up the city wall at some point and was hiding behind the old woman, sticking out half of her head and looking at him timidly, with curiosity and admiration in her eyes.
Xu Changsheng's heart moved slightly.
Just at this moment.
Deep in his Dantian, the Ten Thousand Spirits Tree trembled quietly.
The flower of national destiny, which had been in bud, slowly spread its petals.
A warm and mellow golden air flow overflowed from the petals, slowly flowing along the meridians and infiltrating the limbs and bones.
This power is different from spiritual energy. It is warm and thick, carrying the will of all people.
It is the power of faith for all peoples.
Xu Changsheng closed his eyes and felt the new power in his body.
The so-called power of national destiny comes from the hearts of the people.
It originates from the gratitude and trust from the heart of a protected person.
Just like Chen San back then.
Just like at this moment, the eyes of people all over the city.
Those eyes fell on him with awe, gratitude, and admiration.
The buds of the All Souls Tree are absorbing these seemingly invisible things, blooming quietly little by little.
Xu Changsheng opened his eyes, and a flash of understanding appeared in his eyes.
He is really on the right path this way!
"City Lord Qin, please take a step to speak."
After Xu Changsheng finished speaking, Qin Yue did not hesitate for a moment, immediately handed over the city defense to the deputy general, and followed Xu Changsheng and Hu Jiaojiao down the city wall.
…………
Qin Yue bowed and clasped her fists and said, "Whatever the seniors say, I will do my best."
Xu Changsheng shook his head, "No need to call me senior, my surname is Xu, you can just call me Mr. Xu. This action is not for any reward."
Qin Yue was slightly startled, with a hint of admiration in her eyes.
She has seen too many practitioners.
Or be arrogant and don't take mortals seriously.
Or after helping, you must ask for reward.
Before Qingliu Town was destroyed, there was a monk passing by who could have come to the rescue, but because the town couldn't raise the price he offered, he threw up his sleeves and left.
But the person in front of me clearly has the power to crush everything, but he gives selflessly without asking for anything in return.
This broad-mindedness and responsibility made Qin Yue instantly fond of him.
"Mr. Xu, what can this junior do for you?"
Xu Changsheng thought for a while and asked, "How many villages are there outside Lin'an City?"
Qin Yue didn't expect him to ask this, so she was stunned for a moment before replying: "There are seventeen villages in total, with about three thousand households and more than ten thousand people."
"Black Tiger Village often robs these villages?"
A trace of pain flashed in Qin Yue's eyes, "At least two or three times a month. Those gangsters robbed food, goods, and people. They kidnapped young men and sent them to the stockade to work as coolies, and young women..."
Hu Jiaojiao said angrily: "Scumbags like this should be dealt with slowly. You killed them too happily."
"Are there any other gangsters similar to Black Tiger Village?"
"There is also a Double Dragon Mountain."
